html: The Limilngan, also called Minitja, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Northern Territory, in the country of the lower Mary River east of Darwin. The map shows them from 1600 to 1815. Their language had no known close relatives besides the nearby Wulna and is now extinct. Their neighbours included the Gaagudju and Konbudj to the east, the Wulna to the west and the Kungarakany to the southwest. The anthropologist Norman Tindale recorded them as the Puneitja.
